title: Rayman 3 (Polish)
statusNote: Starts like the original and reaches the first level with the same key script; the story pages are in Polish, the menus and help stay in English.
notes: A fan translation of Rayman 3: the story text is Polish (without Polish diacritics), the menus are still English. The app shows up under the translator's tag, "By ZbYh", instead of the game's name.
Single Player has three save slots; pick an empty one to start. The story pages before the first level can be skipped with the left soft key.
Multiplayer (Host Game, Join Game) needs Bluetooth and a second N-Gage. Do not choose Host Game here: the game stops drawing and has to be restarted.

controls.source: Same as Rayman 3 (the Help screens are unchanged); this variant was only checked to start and to reach the first level with the same keys.

actions.up: Move Rayman; move the arrow in menus
actions.down: Move Rayman; move the arrow in menus
actions.left: Move left; change an option in menus
actions.right: Move right; change an option in menus
actions.lsk: Pause; select in menus; skip the story

notes: Platformer layout: jump (5) on Space or Z and punch (7) on X, besides the digit keys. On a gamepad A or X jumps and B or Y punches; in menus the same buttons select and go back.
